item.description: openJiuwen's RSI-native AgentOS lets agents ship features as hot-pluggable, versioned extension packages. WorkSwarm agents can now write, install and roll back their own plugins.

item.title: MOSS-Live Leads Six Full-Duplex Voice Metrics but Trails GPT-Live-1 on Multi-Turn Tasks
item.description: MOSS-Live tops six full-duplex metrics, wrongly answering background speech 2% of the time. It trails GPT-Live-1 on multi-turn tasks and Doubao on audio understanding.

item.title: The Endless Frontier Open-Sources Fx-Bio-1031, a Qwen-Based Model That Runs Bioinformatics Analyses
item.description: The Endless Frontier's open-weight Fx-Bio-1031 runs multi-step bioinformatics work. It reports 70.59% on BioMysteryBench's hardest subset but trails GPT-6-Astra on BixBench3.

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan's Hy Realtime Voice Model Decides When to Search and Can Sing on Request
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan's Hy Realtime voice model rebuilds intent from half-finished speech, decides when to search the web and sings on request. It is live in Yuanbao voice calls.

item.title: DeepSeek Opens Its App's Search, File, OCR and Voice Tools as APIs So Developers Can Rebuild the App
item.description: DeepSeek has opened web search, deep thinking search, file input, URL reading and safety checks inside its APIs, plus standalone Search, Fetch, OCR, ASR and TTS, so developers can rebuild its app.
